name: cobalt-strike-beacon-interpreter
description: Author, review, and troubleshoot Cobalt Strike Beacon Interpreter C scripts using bundled compatibility guidance, headers, and examples.

interface.longDescription: Write and review Beacon Interpreter C scripts with guidance on packed arguments, supported language features, native FFI, and the supplied header set.
defaultPrompt: Use $cobalt-strike-beacon-interpreter to explain the bundled interpreter demo.
Use $cobalt-strike-beacon-interpreter to review this C script for interpreter compatibility.
Use $cobalt-strike-beacon-interpreter to write a script that reads one packed string argument and prints it.
